title: Signed greatest common divisor
statement: Implement signed_gcd using the Euclidean definition. Return the non-negative greatest common divisor of a and b. The gcd of 0 and 0 is 0.
constraints: inputs exclude the minimum signed 64-bit value
the result fits in a signed 64-bit integer
